items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Goldilocks는 소셜 미디어에 사진을 공유하는 것을 좋아했다.
items.exp: She liked to share photos on social media.에서 확인할 수 있어요. 작은 마을에 살았고 금발이었으며, 처음에는 좋아요를 많이 받지 못했어요.
items.passage: There was a little girl with golden hair in a small town. Her name was Goldilocks. She liked to share photos on social media. At first, she posted everyday things, but people didn't give her many likes.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: There were many students in the room.
There was a cat under the table.
There were a book on the desk.
There was a little girl in the town.
There were three bowls of soup.
items.exp: There was + 단수 명사, There were + 복수 명사예요. a book에는 There was를 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 괄호 안과 같이 바꿔 쓸 때 어색한 것은?
choices: She decided [to post] more pictures. (→ posting)
items.exp: like, love, hate, start는 to부정사와 동명사를 모두 목적어로 취하지만 decide는 to부정사만 목적어로 취해요.

items.q: 다음 중 문장 전환이 올바른 것은?
choices: She sent me a card. = She sent a card for me.
He bought me a bag. = He bought a bag to me.
She gave me a gift. = She gave a gift to me.
She showed me photos. = She showed photos for me.
He made me a cake. = He made a cake to me.
items.exp: give, send, show는 전치사 to, make, buy는 전치사 for를 쓰며, 본문의 give her many likes는 give many likes to her와 같아요.

items.q:
다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?

(a) There were three chairs.
(b) She ate the smallest bowl and take selfies.
(c) Her followers got bored.
(d) Don't posting funny pictures.
(e) I'll think twice before I press POST.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: and로 연결된 동사는 형태를 일치시켜 took. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 부정명령문은 Don't + 동사원형. (e) 옳음. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
( ) 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) She posted (everyday / every day) things.
(B) She posts photos (everyday / every day).
items.exp: everyday는 '일상적인'이라는 형용사로 명사 앞에 쓰고, every day는 '매일'이라는 부사구예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어순이 올바른 문장은?
items.exp: 의문사 + 조동사 + 주어 + 동사원형의 어순이에요.
items.passage: "[What should I do] to get more likes?" she thought.

items.q: 원급 – 비교급 – 최상급이 잘못 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: bad의 비교급과 최상급은 불규칙 변화로 worse – worst예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
items.exp: 조동사 should 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. posting → post.
items.passage: "I know! I should post funny pictures."

items.q: 밑줄 친 were getting과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: It was raining when I got home.
items.exp: were getting은 'be동사 과거형 + 동사원형-ing'인 과거진행형이에요. It was raining도 같은 형태예요. 나머지는 be동사 과거형이에요.
items.passage: Now, her posts [were getting] a lot of likes, and Goldilocks was happy.

items.q:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) She didn't study. ( A ), she passed the test.
(B) It was raining. ( B ), we stayed inside.
(C) I'm tired. ( C ), I have lots of homework.
items.exp: (A) 반대 내용이므로 However(그러나), (B) 결과이므로 Therefore(그러므로), (C) 덧붙이는 내용이므로 Besides(게다가)예요.

items.q:
( ) 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) Her followers got (bored / boring).
(B) The movie is (bored / boring).
(C) We're (excited / exciting) about the trip.
items.exp: 사람이 느끼는 감정은 -ed, 감정을 일으키는 대상은 -ing를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 got과 의미가 같은 것은?
choices: She got a letter from Tom.
items.exp: 본문의 got은 get + 형용사로 '~해졌다'라는 뜻이에요. It got cold도 같은 뜻이에요. 나머지는 '얻다, 받다, 도착하다'예요.
items.passage: Her followers, however, soon [got] bored.

items.q:
주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 가장 알맞은 곳은?

So, she decided to post more shocking pictures.
items.exp: followers가 지루해했기 때문에 So(그래서) 더 충격적인 사진을 올리기로 한 것이므로 ② 자리가 알맞아요.
items.passage: Now, her posts were getting a lot of likes, and Goldilocks was happy. (①) Her followers, however, soon got bored. (②) One day, she was taking a walk in the forest and found a cottage. (③) She knocked on the door, but there was no answer. (④) It was getting dark, and it started to rain. (⑤)

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Goldilocks는 더 많은 좋아요를 받기 위해 웃긴 사진을 올려야겠다고 생각했다.
Goldilocks는 사진 올리는 것을 그만두기로 했다.
Goldilocks는 더 평범한 사진을 올리기로 했다.
items.exp: What should I do to get more likes? 후에 I should post funny pictures.라고 생각했어요. 나중에 followers는 지루해졌고 더 충격적인 사진을 올리기로 했어요.
items.passage: "What should I do to get more likes?" she thought. "I know! I should post funny pictures." Now, her posts were getting a lot of likes, and Goldilocks was happy. Her followers, however, soon got bored. So, she decided to post more shocking pictures.

items.q:
자연스러운 글이 되도록 (A)~(C)를 바르게 배열한 것은?

(A) It was getting dark, and it started to rain.
(B) She knocked on the door, but there was no answer.
(C) She opened the door and walked inside.
items.exp: 오두막을 발견함 → (B) 문을 두드렸지만 대답이 없음 → (A) 어두워지고 비가 옴 → (C) 문을 열고 들어감 순서예요.
items.passage: One day, she was taking a walk in the forest and found a cottage.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: They ate soup and went upstairs.
She knocked on the door and waited.
He opened the door and walked inside.
I got up and washed my face.
She was walking in the forest and find a cottage.
items.exp: and로 연결된 동사는 형태를 일치시켜야 해요. was walking과 연결되는 동사는 과거형 found예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?
items.exp: no answer = not any answer예요. 부정문에서는 any를 쓰고 이중부정은 쓰지 않아요.
items.passage: She knocked on the door, but there was [no answer].

items.q: 다음 중 빈칸에 on이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: She was taking a walk ____ the forest.
items.exp: 숲 안에서 걷는 것은 in the forest예요. 나머지는 모두 on이 쓰여요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 문장의 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: I lost my phone. It was new.
Where is it? I can't find it.
items.exp: 본문의 It은 명암을 나타내는 비인칭 주어예요. It is raining의 It도 날씨를 나타내는 비인칭 주어예요. 나머지는 앞에서 말한 사물을 가리키는 대명사예요.
items.passage: It [was getting dark], and it started to rain.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Goldilocks는 숲에서 오두막을 발견했고 문을 두드렸지만 대답이 없었다.
오두막 안에서 곰이 문을 열어 주었다.
items.exp: She knocked on the door, but there was no answer.에서 알 수 있어요. 그 뒤 문을 열고 안으로 들어갔어요.
items.passage: One day, she was taking a walk in the forest and found a cottage. She knocked on the door, but there was no answer. It was getting dark, and it started to rain. She opened the door and walked inside.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He drank a cup of water.
They bought two bottles of juice.
She ate three bowls of soup.
I need a piece of paper.
She drank two glass of milk.
items.exp: 물질명사는 용기나 단위를 복수형으로 써서 수량을 나타내요. two glass → two glasses.

items.q: 밑줄 친 one이 가리키는 것은?
items.exp: 앞 문장 three bowls of soup에서 나온 bowl of soup의 반복을 피하려고 one을 썼어요.
items.passage: She ate the smallest [one] and took selfies with a smile.

items.q:
빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) She jumped on the smallest chair. ( A ) broke.
(B) These chairs are old. I want new ( B ).
items.exp: (A) 바로 그 의자는 It. (B) 복수 chairs의 반복을 피할 때는 ones예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 with와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: I went there with my dad.
He cut it with a knife.
items.exp: with a smile은 '미소를 지으며'라는 뜻으로 동작의 상태·방법을 나타내요. 나머지는 '~와 함께'나 '~으로(도구)'예요.
items.passage: She ate the smallest one and took selfies [with a smile].

items.q: 밑줄 친 again and again의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
items.exp: again and again은 '몇 번이고, 되풀이해서'라는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: She jumped on the smallest one [again and again].

items.q: 밑줄 친 didn't care의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
items.exp: care는 여기서 '신경 쓰다'라는 뜻이에요. 의자가 부서졌는데도 신경 쓰지 않았다는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: It broke, but she [didn't care].

items.q: 다음 중 어순이 올바른 문장은?
choices: She posted all of the selfie.
She posted the selfies all of.
items.exp: all the + 복수 명사의 어순으로 써요.
items.passage: She took selfies again and posted [all the selfies] on social media.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Goldilocks는 가장 큰 그릇의 수프를 먹었다.
Goldilocks는 가장 작은 의자를 부서뜨렸지만 신경 쓰지 않았다.
items.exp: She jumped on the smallest one again and again. It broke, but she didn't care.에서 알 수 있어요.
items.passage: There were three bowls of soup on a table. She ate the smallest one and took selfies with a smile. There were also three chairs. She jumped on the smallest one again and again. It broke, but she didn't care. "It's so fun!" shouted Goldilocks. She took selfies again and posted all the selfies on social media.

items.q: 동사의 원형과 과거형이 잘못 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: eat의 과거형은 불규칙 변화 ate예요.

items.q:
빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) She fell asleep. About an hour ( A ), three bears came home.
(B) The bears left home two hours ( B ).
items.exp: 기준 시점이 과거인 이야기에서 '~ 후에'는 later, 지금부터 '~ 전에'는 ago예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 cried와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?
items.exp: 여기서 cried는 '울다'가 아니라 '외치다'라는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: "Someone ate my soup and broke my chair!" [cried] Baby Bear.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Father Bear가 Goldilocks 옆에서 휴대폰을 발견했다.
Goldilocks는 곰들이 돌아오기 전에 오두막을 떠났다.
곰 가족은 한 시간 전에 집에 왔다.
items.exp: They went upstairs and saw Goldilocks.에서 알 수 있어요. 휴대폰을 발견한 것은 Mother Bear이고, Baby Bear는 수프와 의자를 말했어요.
items.passage: Then, she went upstairs and found three beds. She felt tired and fell asleep in the smallest bed. About an hour later, three bears came home. "Someone ate my soup and broke my chair!" cried Baby Bear. They went upstairs and saw Goldilocks. Mother Bear found a phone next to Goldilocks. "This is terrible!" "Look at all these posts of our home," shouted Mother Bear angrily.

items.q: 원급 – 부사가 잘못 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: 「자음 + y」로 끝나는 형용사는 y를 i로 고치고 -ly를 붙여서 easily가 돼요.

items.q:
빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) ( A ) smartphones, we can find information.
(B) We can't live ( B ) water.
items.exp: (A) 스마트폰이 있으면 정보를 찾을 수 있다는 뜻이라 With. (B) 물 없이 살 수 없다는 뜻이라 without이에요.

items.q: 'Don't you know these things are wrong?'에 대해 '네, 알아요.'라고 대답할 때 알맞은 것은?
items.exp: 부정의문문에서도 Yes/No는 대답의 내용에 따라 정해져요. 안다면 Yes, I do.예요.
items.passage: "Don't you know these things are wrong?" said Father Bear.

items.q: 다음 중 부정명령문이 올바른 것은?
items.exp: 부정명령문은 Don't + 동사원형으로 써요.
items.passage: "Please forgive me." / "Please don't worry."

items.q:
( ) 안에서 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) I'll clean the house (until / by) Friday. (Friday까지 계속)
(B) Finish your homework (until / by) 6 p.m. (6시 마감)
items.exp: until은 어떤 시점까지 계속되는 동작에, by는 어떤 시점까지 완료해야 하는 일에 써요.

items.q:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) ( A ) the last day
(B) ( B ) June 2nd
(C) ( C ) the morning
items.exp: 특정한 날 앞에는 on, 아침·오후·저녁 앞에는 in을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 on과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: Don't spend too much time on social media.
We have a test on Friday.
I saw the news on TV.
The book is on the table.
items.exp: 본문의 on은 '계속'의 뜻을 나타내는 부사예요. talked on for hours의 on도 같아요. 나머지는 전치사예요.
items.passage: Your posts will live [on] forever.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Before I will go to bed, I will brush my teeth.
I'll call you when I arrive.
When it rains, we will stay home.
After she finishes dinner, she will watch TV.
Before I go to bed, I will brush my teeth.
items.exp: 시간 부사절에서는 미래의 일이라도 현재시제를 써요. will go → go.

items.q: 다음 중 어순이 올바른 문장은?
choices: I deleted all of my post.
items.exp: all + 소유격 + 명사의 어순으로 써요.
items.passage: "I deleted all my posts of your cottage, so please don't worry."

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Goldilocks는 게시물을 지워서 문제가 모두 해결되었다.
Goldilocks는 앞으로 게시물을 더 많이 올릴 것이다.
곰 가족은 Goldilocks를 곧바로 용서해 주었다.
Father Bear는 게시물이 다른 사람들에 의해 이미 공유되었다고 말했다.
Goldilocks는 여름 내내 아무것도 하지 않았다.
items.exp: Other people already shared them on social media.라고 했어요. Goldilocks는 여름 내내 열심히 일했고, 앞으로는 게시 전에 두 번 생각하겠다고 했어요.
items.passage: All summer long, Goldilocks worked hard. On the last day, Goldilocks said to Father Bear, "I deleted all my posts of your cottage, so please don't worry." "You still don't understand." "Other people already shared them on social media." "Your posts will live on forever," said Father Bear. "Oh, I didn't think about that," said Goldilocks. "From now on, I'll think twice before I press POST."

items.q: 밑줄 친 that이 가리키는 것은?
choices: 다른 사람들이 이미 게시물을 공유했다는 것
items.exp: Father Bear가 게시물이 이미 공유되어 영원히 남아있을 것이라고 한 말을 가리켜요.
items.passage: "Other people already shared them on social media." ... "Oh, I didn't think about [that]," said Goldilocks.

items.q: 밑줄 친 that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: I learned [that] I should be careful.
items.exp: 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 that은 생략할 수 있어요. 나머지는 '저, 그'라는 뜻의 지시어예요.
items.passage: I think [that] Goldilocks was careless.

items.q:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

She didn't know that other people ______ share her posts.
items.exp: 주절이 과거(didn't know)이므로 that절도 과거 형태 could로 일치시켜요.
items.passage: Goldilocks broke into the Bear family's house. She ate a bowl of soup and broke a chair. She also took selfies at the Bear family's house and posted them on social media without their permission. I think Goldilocks was careless. She didn't know that other people could share her posts. This story taught me a lesson. I learned that I should be careful when I post something on social media.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 글쓴이는 소셜 미디어를 쓰지 않기로 했다.
글쓴이는 Goldilocks가 다른 사람이 게시물을 공유할 수 있다는 것을 몰랐다고 생각한다.
items.exp: I think Goldilocks was careless. She didn't know that other people could share her posts.에서 알 수 있어요.
items.passage: Goldilocks broke into the Bear family's house. She ate a bowl of soup and broke a chair. She also took selfies at the Bear family's house and posted them on social media without their permission. I think Goldilocks was careless. She didn't know that other people could share her posts. This story taught me a lesson. I learned that I should be careful when I post something on social media.

items.q: 밑줄 친 give away의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
items.exp: give away your personal information은 '개인 정보를 알려 주다, 누설하다'라는 뜻이에요.
items.passage:
Don't lie on social media.
Don't spend too much time on social media.
Don't [give away] your personal information on social media.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He checks his phone every ten minute.
He checks social media every five minutes.
She calls me every two days.
items.exp: every + 숫자 + 복수 명사의 형태이므로 minute → minutes예요.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 수호는 소셜 미디어를 거의 확인하지 않는다.
items.exp: He checks social media every five minutes.에서 확인할 수 있어요. 이야기하고 웃는 사람은 다른 학생들이에요.
items.passage:
#1 Suho gets up in the morning and checks social media first.
#2 At lunch break at school, Suho can't take his eyes off his phone. He checks social media every five minutes. Other students talk and laugh together.
